      .proof { position:fixed; z-index:20; inset:clamp(54px,7.2vh,66px) 0 0 auto; width:min(92vw,480px); border-left:1px solid var(--border); box-shadow:-16px 0 40px rgb(15 23 42 / .16); transform:translateX(102%); transition:transform .2s ease; }
      .proof.open { transform:translateX(0); }
      .sidebar-toggle { display:inline-flex; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">
  <header class="topbar">
    {% if workflow_enabled %}<img class="logo" src="/static/muclegal-logo-light.png" alt="MucLegal">{% else %}<strong>MucLegal</strong>{% endif %}
    <div class="separator"></div>
    <div class="brand-copy"><strong>Unterlassungs- und Umsetzungsmonitor</strong><span>Juristische Vorprüfung mit menschlicher Entscheidung</span></div>
    <span class="badge">Hackathon-Prototyp</span>
    <a class="lab-link" href="/beweis-labor">Beweislabor</a>
    <button id="sidebar-toggle" class="button sidebar-toggle" type="button">Proof</button>
  </header>

  <div class="workspace">
    <main class="control{% if case_intake_enabled %} intake-mode{% endif %}">
      {% if case_intake_enabled %}
      <details class="card card-pad tenor-panel" open>
        <summary>1 · Bekannten Erstverstoß erfassen</summary>
        <p style="margin-top:7px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px">Die Verbraucherzentrale meldet den bereits geprüften Verstoß. MucLegal sucht keine Erstverstöße; ein Screenshot dient nur als Beleg und wird nicht visuell ausgewertet.</p>
        <form id="case-intake-form" class="tenor-grid">
          <input id="intake-fall-id" class="input" required maxlength="200" placeholder="Fall-ID" aria-label="Fall-ID">
          <input id="intake-domain" class="input" required maxlength="253" placeholder="example.de" aria-label="Domain">
          <input id="intake-source-url" class="input wide" type="url" required maxlength="2048" placeholder="https://example.de/agb" aria-label="Konkrete Fundstellen-URL">
          <select id="intake-type" class="select" aria-label="Verstoßtyp"><option value="klausel">Klausel</option><option value="element">Button / Element</option></select>
          <input id="intake-pages" class="input" required value="AGB, Startseite" aria-label="Relevante Seitentypen">
          <textarea id="intake-target-urls" class="input wide" maxlength="12000" placeholder="Verbindliche Prüf-URLs · eine URL pro Zeile
https://example.de/
https://example.de/policies/terms-of-service" aria-label="Verbindliche Prüf-URLs"></textarea>
          <textarea id="intake-description" class="input wide" required maxlength="4000" placeholder="Von der Verbraucherzentrale festgestellter Verstoß" aria-label="Beschreibung"></textarea>
          <textarea id="intake-tenor" class="input wide" required maxlength="8000" placeholder="Freigegebener Tenor oder tragendes Tenorelement" aria-label="Tenorelement"></textarea>
          <textarea id="intake-target" class="input wide" required maxlength="4000" placeholder="Was soll künftig gefunden oder vermisst werden?" aria-label="Monitoringziel"></textarea>
          <textarea id="intake-not-covered" class="input wide" maxlength="6000" placeholder="Nicht umfasst · eine Abgrenzung pro Zeile" aria-label="Nicht vom Fallprofil umfasst"></textarea>
          <textarea id="intake-clause" class="input wide conditional" required maxlength="12000" placeholder="Beanstandeter Wortlaut der Klausel" aria-label="Beanstandeter Klauselwortlaut"></textarea>
          <div id="intake-element-fields" class="wide tenor-grid conditional" hidden>
            <input id="intake-element-label" class="input" maxlength="1000" placeholder="Bezeichnung des Elements" aria-label="Elementbezeichnung">
            <select id="intake-element-error" class="select" aria-label="Fehlerart">{% for error in element_errors %}<option value="{{ error }}">{{ error }}</option>{% endfor %}</select>
            <textarea id="intake-element-labels" class="input wide" maxlength="4000" placeholder="Weitere beobachtete Button-Bezeichnungen · eine pro Zeile" aria-label="Weitere Button-Bezeichnungen"></textarea>
            <textarea id="intake-element-function" class="input wide" maxlength="2000" placeholder="Erwartete Funktion des Elements" aria-label="Elementfunktion"></textarea>
          </div>
          <label class="input wide" style="display:block">Optionaler Screenshot des Erstverstoßes · nur Beweismittel<input id="intake-screenshot" type="file" accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp" style="display:block;margin-top:5px"></label>
          <button class="button primary" type="submit">Fall zur menschlichen Prüfung speichern</button>
          <span id="intake-status" class="status-chip">noch nicht gespeichert</span>
        </form>
        <div id="monitoring-case-list" class="case-list">
          {% for item in monitoring_cases %}
          <div class="case-row" data-case-id="{{ item.case_id }}"><div><strong>{{ item.fall_id }} · {{ item.violation_type }}</strong><small>Erstverstoß: Verbraucherzentrale · {{ item.target_urls|length }} verbindliche Prüf-URL(s) · {{ item.source_url }}</small></div><div><span class="status-chip{% if item.decision == 'freigegeben' %} ok{% endif %}">{{ item.decision }}</span>{% if item.decision != 'freigegeben' %}<button class="button case-review" type="button" data-decision="freigegeben">Fall freigeben</button>{% endif %}</div></div>
          {% endfor %}
        </div>
      </details>
      {% endif %}

      <details class="card card-pad tenor-panel"{% if not active_tenor or (tenor_draft and tenor_draft.decision != 'freigegeben') %} open{% endif %}>
        <summary>{% if case_intake_enabled %}2{% else %}1{% endif %} · Unterlassungstenor prüfen und freigeben</summary>
        {% if workflow_enabled %}
        <form method="post" action="/tenor-draft" class="tenor-grid">
          <input class="input" name="fall_id" required maxlength="200" value="VZ-2024-0417" aria-label="Fall-ID">
          <input class="input" name="schuldner" required maxlength="500" value="Beispiel Möbel GmbH" aria-label="Schuldner">
          <input class="input wide" name="fundstelle" required maxlength="2048" value="https://example.org/angebote" aria-label="Fundstelle">
          <textarea class="input wide" name="beschreibung" required maxlength="4000" aria-label="Festgestellter Verstoß">mit künstlicher Dringlichkeit für eine Rabattaktion zu werben, obwohl die angegebene Befristung tatsächlich nicht besteht</textarea>
          <input class="input wide" name="rechtsgrundlagen" required value="§ 5 UWG, § 8 Abs. 1 UWG" aria-label="Belegte Rechtsgrundlagen, kommagetrennt">
          <button class="button primary" type="submit">Prüfentwurf erstellen</button>
        </form>
        {% endif %}
        {% if tenor_draft %}
        <div class="tenor-draft">
          <strong>KI-/Demo-Entwurf · {{ tenor_draft.mode }}</strong>
          <p>{{ tenor_draft.draft.entwurf }}</p>
          <p><strong>Nicht umfasst:</strong> {{ tenor_draft.draft.nicht_umfasst|join(", ") }}</p>
          <div class="tenor-actions">
            <span class="status-chip{% if tenor_draft.decision == 'freigegeben' %} ok{% endif %}">{{ tenor_draft.decision or "MENSCHLICHE PRÜFUNG OFFEN" }}</span>
            {% if workflow_enabled %}<form method="post" action="/tenor-review"><input type="hidden" name="draft_id" value="{{ tenor_draft.draft_id }}"><button class="button" name="decision" value="freigegeben">Tenor freigeben</button><button class="button" name="decision" value="abgelehnt">Ablehnen</button><button class="button" name="decision" value="weitere_pruefung">Offen</button></form>{% endif %}
          </div>
        </div>
        {% elif active_tenor %}<div class="tenor-draft"><strong>Aktiver, synthetischer Demo-Tenor</strong><p>{{ active_tenor.tenor }}</p></div>{% endif %}
      </details>

      <section class="card card-pad">
        <div class="url-head">
          <div><h1>{% if case_intake_enabled %}3 · Umsetzung überwachen{% else %}2 · Umsetzung auf öffentlicher URL überwachen{% endif %}</h1><p>{% if case_intake_enabled %}Nur ein von der Verbraucherzentrale gemeldeter und menschlich freigegebener Fall kann gestartet werden.{% else %}Der erste Abruf speichert die Baseline. Nur eine relevante spätere Änderung startet die juristische Vorprüfung und Beweissicherung.{% endif %}</p></div>
          <span class="badge">Mensch entscheidet</span>
        </div>
        {% if workflow_enabled %}
        <form id="run-form" class="url-form">
          {% if case_intake_enabled %}
          <select id="monitoring-case" class="select" required aria-label="Freigegebenen Monitoringfall wählen"><option value="">Freigegebenen Fall wählen</option>{% for item in monitoring_cases if item.decision == 'freigegeben' %}<option value="{{ item.case_id }}">{{ item.fall_id }} · {{ item.domain }}</option>{% endfor %}</select>
          {% else %}
          <input id="url" class="input" name="url" type="url" required placeholder="https://www.beispiel.de/angebote" aria-label="Webadresse">
          {% endif %}
          <button id="run-button" class="button primary" type="submit"{% if not anthropic_ready and not case_intake_enabled %} disabled{% endif %}>Monitoring starten</button>
        </form>
        {% if not anthropic_ready and not case_intake_enabled %}<div class="alert warning">ANTHROPIC_API_KEY fehlt am Server. Ein Schlüssel wird nie im Browser eingegeben.</div>{% endif %}
        {% else %}<div class="alert">Offline-Demolauf – Live-Abruf ist in dieser Ansicht deaktiviert.</div>{% endif %}
      </section>

      <section class="card pipeline-card">
        <div class="section-row"><h2>3 · Technischer Prüfpfad</h2><span id="terminal-badge" class="status-chip">wartend</span></div>
        <div class="steps" id="steps">
          {% for key,label in [("fetch","Abruf"),("normalize","Normalisierung"),("screenshot","Screenshot"),("compare","Vergleich"),("anthropic","Anthropic"),("warc","WARC"),("manifest","Manifest"),("timestamp","TSA/PDF")] %}
          <div class="step" data-step="{{ key }}" data-state="waiting"><span class="step-dot"></span><span class="step-name">{{ label }}</span><span class="step-state">wartend</span></div>
          {% endfor %}
        </div>
        <div class="run-status" aria-live="polite"><strong id="run-code">Bereit</strong><span id="run-message">Noch kein Lauf in dieser Sitzung.</span></div>
      </section>

      <div class="tech-grid">
        <section class="card metric-card">
          <div class="metric-head"><h2>4 · Juristische Vorprüfung</h2><span id="schema-chip" class="status-chip">kein Ergebnis</span></div>
          <dl class="metric-list">
            <div class="metric"><dt>Vierklassen-Befund</dt><dd id="four-class-result">{% if case and case.clause_findings %}{{ case.clause_findings[0].classification }}{% else %}—{% endif %}</dd></div>
            <div class="metric"><dt>Klauselpaare</dt><dd id="clause-pair-count">{{ case.clause_findings|length if case and case.clause_findings else "—" }}</dd></div>
            <div class="metric"><dt>Aggregat</dt><dd id="result-code">{{ case.assessment.ergebnis if case else "—" }}</dd></div>
            <div class="metric"><dt>Confidence</dt><dd id="confidence">{% if case %}{{ "%.0f"|format(case.assessment.confidence * 100) }} %{% else %}—{% endif %}</dd></div>
            <div class="metric"><dt>Schema</dt><dd id="schema-valid">{% if case %}valide{% else %}—{% endif %}</dd></div>
            <div class="metric"><dt>Modus</dt><dd id="analysis-mode">{{ case.analysis_mode if case else "—" }}</dd></div>
          </dl>
        </section>
        <section class="card metric-card">
          <div class="metric-head"><h2>5 · Beweisstatus</h2><span id="evidence-chip" class="status-chip">lokal</span></div>
          <dl class="metric-list">
            <div class="metric"><dt>Aktueller Hash</dt><dd><code id="current-hash">{{ case.snapshot_sha256 if case and case.snapshot_sha256 else "—" }}</code></dd></div>
            <div class="metric"><dt>Vorheriger Hash</dt><dd><code id="previous-hash">{{ case.previous_snapshot_sha256 if case and case.previous_snapshot_sha256 else "—" }}</code></dd></div>
            <div class="metric"><dt>WARC</dt><dd id="warc-status">{{ case.evidence.warc_status if case else "—" }}</dd></div>
            <div class="metric"><dt>Aufnahmebezug</dt><dd id="capture-relation">{{ case.evidence.capture_relation if case and case.evidence.capture_relation else "—" }}</dd></div>
            <div class="metric"><dt>Manifest</dt><dd id="manifest-status">{% if case %}verifiziert{% else %}—{% endif %}</dd></div>
            <div class="metric"><dt>TSA / PDF</dt><dd id="tsa-status">{% if case %}{{ case.evidence.timestamp_status }} / erzeugt{% else %}—{% endif %}</dd></div>
          </dl>
        </section>
      </div>

      <section class="card review">
        <div class="review-copy"><h2>6 · Menschlich entscheiden</h2><p>Das Modell setzt <code>freigabe_durch_mensch: null</code>.</p></div>
        <span class="status-chip{% if human_review %} ok{% endif %}">{% if human_review %}MENSCHLICH: {{ human_review.decision|upper }}{% else %}MENSCHLICHE PRÜFUNG OFFEN{% endif %}</span>
        {% if case %}<form method="post" action="/review"><button class="button" name="decision" value="freigegeben">Freigeben</button><button class="button" name="decision" value="abgelehnt">Ablehnen</button><button class="button" name="decision" value="weitere_pruefung">Offen</button></form>{% endif %}
      </section>
    </main>

    <aside class="proof" id="proof-sidebar" aria-label="Proof und Artefakte">
      <div class="proof-inner">
        <div class="proof-head">
          <div class="proof-title"><div><h1>Proof & Artefakte</h1><p>Lokale Beweispakete nach URL und Zeitpunkt</p></div><button id="sidebar-close" class="button sidebar-toggle" type="button">Schließen</button></div>
          <div class="selectors"><select id="url-select" class="select" aria-label="URL wählen"><option value="">Keine URL</option></select><select id="run-select" class="select" aria-label="Beweislauf wählen"><option value="">Kein Lauf</option></select></div>
        </div>
        <section id="proof-summary" class="card proof-summary"><div class="summary-url">Noch kein vollständiges Beweispaket</div><div class="summary-grid"><div><span>Status</span><strong>—</strong></div><div><span>Zeitpunkt</span><strong>—</strong></div></div></section>
        <div id="artifact-groups"></div>
        <section class="card preview" id="preview-card">
          <div class="preview-bar"><strong id="preview-title">Vorschau</strong><a id="preview-open" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener" hidden>Öffnen / laden</a></div>
          <div id="preview-empty" class="preview-empty">Artefakt auswählen. HTML wird ausschließlich als ungefährlicher Quelltext dargestellt.</div>
          <pre id="text-preview" hidden></pre>
          <img id="image-preview" class="image-preview" alt="Gespeicherter Full-Page-Screenshot" hidden>
          <iframe id="pdf-preview" class="pdf-frame" title="PDF-Vorschau" hidden></iframe>
        </section>
      </div>
    </aside>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const terminal = new Set(["baseline_created","unchanged","completed","completed_with_warnings","failed","referenzzustand_dokumentiert","unveraendert_fortbestehend","beseitigt","kerngleich_wiederaufgetreten","neuer_sachverhalt","unsicher","pruefung_unvollstaendig"]);
  const stateLabels = {waiting:"wartend",active:"aktiv",success:"erfolgreich",skipped:"übersprungen",warning:"Warnung",failed:"fehlgeschlagen"};
  const runForm = document.getElementById("run-form");
  const runButton = document.getElementById("run-button");
  const sidebar = document.getElementById("proof-sidebar");
  document.getElementById("sidebar-toggle").addEventListener("click", () => sidebar.classList.add("open"));
  document.getElementById("sidebar-close").addEventListener("click", () => sidebar.classList.remove("open"));

  function setSteps(states) {
    document.querySelectorAll(".step").forEach(step => {
      const state = states?.[step.dataset.step] || "waiting";
      step.dataset.state = state;
      step.querySelector(".step-state").textContent = stateLabels[state] || state;
    });
  }
  function setRun(run) {
    setSteps(run.steps);
    document.getElementById("run-code").textContent = run.status;
    document.getElementById("run-message").textContent = run.message;
    const chip = document.getElementById("terminal-badge");
    chip.textContent = run.status;
    chip.className = "status-chip " + (run.status === "completed" ? "ok" : (run.status.includes("warning") || run.status === "failed" ? "warn" : ""));
  }
  async function api(url, options) {
    const response = await fetch(url, options);
    if (!response.ok) {
      let message = `HTTP ${response.status}`;
      try { message = (await response.json()).detail || message; } catch (_) {}
      throw new Error(message);
    }
    return response.json();
  }
  if (runForm) runForm.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
    event.preventDefault(); runButton.disabled = true; setSteps();
    try {
      const caseSelect=document.getElementById("monitoring-case"), urlInput=document.getElementById("url");
      const payload=caseSelect?{case_id:caseSelect.value}:{url:urlInput.value};
      let run = await api("/api/runs", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(payload)});
      setRun(run);
      while (!terminal.has(run.status)) { await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve,450)); run = await api(`/api/runs/${run.run_id}`); setRun(run); }
      if (run.result_available) await loadCases(true);
    } catch (error) {
      document.getElementById("run-code").textContent = "failed";
      document.getElementById("run-message").textContent = error.message;
    } finally { runButton.disabled = false; }
  });

  const intakeForm=document.getElementById("case-intake-form"), intakeType=document.getElementById("intake-type");
  function toggleIntakeType() {
    if (!intakeType) return; const element=intakeType.value==="element";
    document.getElementById("intake-clause").hidden=element; document.getElementById("intake-clause").required=!element;
    document.getElementById("intake-element-fields").hidden=!element;
    ["intake-element-label","intake-element-function","intake-element-error"].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).required=element);
  }
  if (intakeType) { intakeType.addEventListener("change",toggleIntakeType); toggleIntakeType(); }
  async function screenshotPayload(file) {
    if (!file) return null; const bytes=new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()); let binary="";
    for(let offset=0;offset<bytes.length;offset+=0x8000) binary+=String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(offset,offset+0x8000));
    return {filename:file.name,media_type:file.type,data_base64:btoa(binary)};
  }
  if (intakeForm) intakeForm.addEventListener("submit",async event=>{
    event.preventDefault(); const status=document.getElementById("intake-status"); status.textContent="wird gespeichert";
    try {
      const type=intakeType.value, file=document.getElementById("intake-screenshot").files[0];
      const lines=id=>document.getElementById(id).value.split(/\r?\n/).map(v=>v.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      const payload={fall_id:document.getElementById("intake-fall-id").value,domain:document.getElementById("intake-domain").value,source_url:document.getElementById("intake-source-url").value,violation_type:type,description:document.getElementById("intake-description").value,tenor_element:document.getElementById("intake-tenor").value,monitoring_target:document.getElementById("intake-target").value,relevant_page_types:document.getElementById("intake-pages").value.split(",").map(v=>v.trim()).filter(Boolean),target_urls:lines("intake-target-urls"),nicht_umfasst:lines("intake-not-covered"),clause_text:type==="klausel"?document.getElementById("intake-clause").value:null,element_label:type==="element"?document.getElementById("intake-element-label").value:null,element_labels:type==="element"?lines("intake-element-labels"):[],element_function:type==="element"?document.getElementById("intake-element-function").value:null,element_error:type==="element"?document.getElementById("intake-element-error").value:null,allowed_subdomains:[],screenshot:await screenshotPayload(file)};
      const created=await api("/api/v1/cases",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(payload)}); status.textContent=`${created.fall_id} · menschliche Prüfung offen`; location.reload();
    } catch(error) { status.textContent=error.message; status.className="status-chip warn"; }
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(".case-review").forEach(button=>button.addEventListener("click",async()=>{
    const caseId=button.closest("[data-case-id]").dataset.caseId;
    try { await api(`/api/v1/cases/${encodeURIComponent(caseId)}/review`,{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({decision:button.dataset.decision})}); location.reload(); } catch(error) { alert(error.message); }
  }));

  const urlSelect = document.getElementById("url-select");
  const runSelect = document.getElementById("run-select");
  let allCases = [];
  async function loadCases(selectNewest=false) {
    try { allCases = (await api("/api/cases")).cases; } catch (_) { allCases = []; }
    const previous = urlSelect.value;
    const urls = [...new Set(allCases.map(item => item.url))];
    urlSelect.replaceChildren(...(urls.length ? urls.map(url => new Option(url,url)) : [new Option("Keine URL","")]));
    if (!selectNewest && urls.includes(previous)) urlSelect.value = previous;
    populateRuns();
  }
  function populateRuns() {
    const cases = allCases.filter(item => item.url === urlSelect.value);
    runSelect.replaceChildren(...(cases.length ? cases.map(item => new Option(formatDate(item.erkannt_am),item.case_id)) : [new Option("Kein Lauf","")]));
    if (cases.length) loadCase(cases[0].case_id); else renderEmpty();
  }
  function formatDate(value) { const date = new Date(value); return Number.isNaN(date.valueOf()) ? value : date.toLocaleString("de-DE"); }
  urlSelect.addEventListener("change", populateRuns);
  runSelect.addEventListener("change", () => runSelect.value && loadCase(runSelect.value));

  async function loadCase(caseId) {
    const data = await api(`/api/cases/${encodeURIComponent(caseId)}`);
    renderSummary(data); renderArtifacts(data); renderTechnical(data);
  }
  function renderSummary(data) {
    const summary = document.getElementById("proof-summary"); summary.replaceChildren();
    const url = document.createElement("div"); url.className="summary-url"; url.textContent=data.url; summary.append(url);
    const grid = document.createElement("div"); grid.className="summary-grid";
    [["Status",data.status],["Zeitpunkt",formatDate(data.erkannt_am)],["Manifest",short(data.manifest_sha256)],["Snapshot",short(data.snapshot_sha256)]].forEach(([label,value]) => {
      const box=document.createElement("div"),span=document.createElement("span"),strong=document.createElement("strong"); span.textContent=label; strong.textContent=value||"—"; box.append(span,strong); grid.append(box);
    }); summary.append(grid);
  }
  function renderTechnical(data) {
    text("four-class-result",data.four_class_result); text("clause-pair-count",data.clause_pair_count);
    text("result-code",data.result_code); text("confidence",data.confidence == null ? "—" : `${Math.round(data.confidence*100)} %`);
    text("schema-valid",data.schema_valid ? "valide" : "ungültig"); text("current-hash",data.snapshot_sha256); text("previous-hash",data.previous_snapshot_sha256);
    text("warc-status",data.warc_status); text("capture-relation",data.capture_relation); text("manifest-status",data.manifest_sha256 ? "verifiziert" : "fehlt"); text("tsa-status",`${data.timestamp_status||"—"} / ${data.artifacts.some(a=>a.label==="report"&&a.available)?"erzeugt":"fehlt"}`);
    const schema=document.getElementById("schema-chip"); schema.textContent=data.schema_valid?"schema-valide":"ungültig"; schema.className=`status-chip ${data.schema_valid?"ok":"warn"}`;
    const evidence=document.getElementById("evidence-chip"); evidence.textContent=data.status; evidence.className=`status-chip ${data.status==="completed"?"ok":"warn"}`;
  }
  function text(id,value) { document.getElementById(id).textContent=value||"—"; }
  function short(value) { return value ? `${value.slice(0,10)}…${value.slice(-6)}` : "—"; }
  function renderArtifacts(data) {
    const root=document.getElementById("artifact-groups"); root.replaceChildren();
    ["Abruf","Analyse","Beweis","Bericht"].forEach(groupName => {
      const section=document.createElement("section"); section.className="artifact-group"; const title=document.createElement("h3"); title.textContent=groupName; section.append(title);
      const list=document.createElement("div"); list.className="artifact-list";
      data.artifacts.filter(a=>a.group===groupName).forEach(artifact => {
        const button=document.createElement("button"); button.type="button"; button.className="artifact"; button.disabled=!artifact.available; button.title=artifact.available ? `${artifact.size} Bytes` : "Artefakt fehlt oder ist unvollständig";
        const mark=document.createElement("span"); mark.className="artifact-mark"; const label=document.createElement("span"); label.textContent=artifact.available?artifact.title:`${artifact.title} · fehlt`; button.append(mark,label);
        if (artifact.available) button.addEventListener("click",()=>preview(data.case_id,artifact,button)); list.append(button);
      }); section.append(list); root.append(section);

import json

import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from muclegal.demo import run_demo
from muclegal.evidence import OpenSslTsaClient, verify_manifest
from muclegal.ui import create_app


class GoldenPathTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_offline_golden_path_and_human_review(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as output:
            tsa = OpenSslTsaClient(
                tsa_url="http://127.0.0.1:1/tsr", timeout_seconds=0.1, max_attempts=1
            )
            result = run_demo("kerngleich", output, tsa_client=tsa)
            case = json.loads(Path(result.case_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            self.assertEqual("pending", result.timestamp_status)
            self.assertEqual("kerngleich_umfasst", case["assessment"]["ergebnis"])
            self.assertEqual("kerngleich", case["clause_findings"][0]["classification"])
            self.assertTrue(case["clause_schema_valid"])
            self.assertTrue(Path(case["artifacts"]["clause_model_input"]).is_file())
            self.assertTrue(Path(case["artifacts"]["clause_model_output"]).is_file())
            self.assertIsNone(case["assessment"]["freigabe_durch_mensch"])
            self.assertIsNone(case["freigabe_durch_mensch"])
            self.assertTrue(verify_manifest(case["artifacts"]["manifest"]).valid)
            self.assertTrue(Path(result.report_path).is_file())

            app = create_app(result.case_path, Path(output) / "reviews.sqlite3")
            client = TestClient(app)
            page = client.get("/")
            self.assertEqual(200, page.status_code)
            self.assertIn("MENSCHLICHE PRÜFUNG OFFEN", page.text)
            self.assertIn("freigabe_durch_mensch: null", page.text)
            review = client.post(
                "/review",
                content="decision=freigegeben",
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
                follow_redirects=True,
            )
            self.assertEqual(200, review.status_code)
            self.assertIn("MENSCHLICH: FREIGEGEBEN", review.text)
            unchanged_case = json.loads(Path(result.case_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            self.assertIsNone(unchanged_case["assessment"]["freigabe_durch_mensch"])

    def test_both_legal_demo_cases_are_schema_valid(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as output:
            tsa = OpenSslTsaClient(
                tsa_url="http://127.0.0.1:1/tsr", timeout_seconds=0.1, max_attempts=1
            )
            covered = run_demo("kerngleich", Path(output) / "covered", tsa_client=tsa)
            not_covered = run_demo("nicht-umfasst", Path(output) / "not-covered", tsa_client=tsa)
            covered_case = json.loads(Path(covered.case_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            not_covered_case = json.loads(Path(not_covered.case_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual("kerngleich_umfasst", covered_case["assessment"]["ergebnis"])
        self.assertEqual("nicht_umfasst", not_covered_case["assessment"]["ergebnis"])
        self.assertEqual("kerngleich", covered_case["clause_findings"][0]["classification"])
        self.assertEqual(
            "neuer_sachverhalt",
            not_covered_case["clause_findings"][0]["classification"],
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        if self.path == "/robots.txt":
            body = type(self).robots_body
            status = type(self).robots_status
            content_type = "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
        else:
            body = type(self).page

class LiveServer:
    def __enter__(self):
        _LiveHandler.page = (FIXTURES / "baseline.html").read_bytes()
        _LiveHandler.robots_status = 200
        _LiveHandler.robots_body = b"User-agent: *\nAllow: /\n"
        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), _LiveHandler)
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()
        self.url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_port}/page"
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *args):
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()

        output = Path(output_directory)
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        query = output / "manifest.tsq"
        query.write_bytes(b"query")
        return SimpleNamespace(status=self.status, query_path=str(query), response_path=None)


def fake_warc(url: str, output_directory: str | Path):
    del url
    output = Path(output_directory)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    warc = output / "capture.warc.gz"
    cdx = output / "capture.cdx"
    warc.write_bytes(b"warc")
    cdx.write_text("cdx", encoding="utf-8")
    return SimpleNamespace(warc_path=str(warc), cdx_path=str(cdx))


def mismatched_warc(url: str, output_directory: str | Path):
    result = fake_warc(url, output_directory)
    return SimpleNamespace(
        warc_path=result.warc_path,
        cdx_path=result.cdx_path,
        response_payload_sha256="0" * 64,
    )


def fake_report(report: dict, output_path: str | Path) -> str:
    self_contained = Path(output_path)
    self_contained.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    return str(self_contained)


def local_fetcher() -> HttpFetcher:
    return HttpFetcher(
        FetchPolicy(
            timeout_seconds=2,
            max_attempts=1,
            retry_backoff_seconds=0,
            require_public_network=False,
        )
    )


def poll(client: TestClient, run_id: str) -> dict:
    for _ in range(200):
        result = client.get(f"/api/runs/{run_id}").json()
        if result["status"] in TERMINAL_RUN_STATUSES:
            return result
        time.sleep(0.01)
    raise AssertionError("Prüflauf wurde nicht rechtzeitig beendet.")
